{{Top|leg}}
'''Stun sticks''' were personal defense weapons. They were usually carried by famous entertainers such as [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] [[Actor/Legends|actresses]].

[[501-Z police droid]]s carried stun sticks which allowed them to subdue criminals and suspects if a physical confrontation ensued from them carrying out their duty.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
